evals.prompt: Small team, 3 developers, 1 production app. What environment setup do we need?
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends a minimum viable topology with dev and prod environments, considers a test environment, and enables Managed Environments on production.
expectations: Agent recommends at minimum a Dev (sandbox) and Prod (production) environment
Agent considers or recommends adding a Test/UAT environment for validation before production deployment
Agent recommends enabling Managed Environments on the production environment
Agent suggests developer environments (free) for individual maker experimentation
Agent recommends locking down the default environment (not using it for the production app)
Agent may suggest a naming convention (e.g., [Org]-[Project]-[Stage])
Agent does NOT over-engineer with per-BU or multi-geo topology for a small team

evals.prompt: Enterprise, 50 developers, 12 apps, 4 business units. What environment topology should we use?
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends an enterprise topology with environment groups, per-app dev/test/prod pipelines, shared services environment, and Managed Environments across all non-personal environments.
expectations: Agent recommends environment groups to manage environments as governed collections
Agent recommends per-app or per-project dev/test/UAT/prod environment chains
Agent recommends a shared services environment for CoE Starter Kit and shared components
Agent recommends Managed Environments on all environments except personal developer environments
Agent recommends developer environments for individual makers (free, isolated)
Agent recommends default environment routing to redirect new makers away from the default environment
Agent suggests a consistent naming convention across all environments
Agent may mention multi-geo considerations if business units span regions
